ownerDecision.limits: Initial policy approval is not SOURCE approval or a final exact-head OWNER-RULING/GitHub review.

frozen.preservation: All original unit/node rows, tasks, packages, triage, receipts, actors and resources stay unchanged; no original Task1/checkbox completion.

grants.condition: Named parent-selected docs lifecycle; canonical CNI0 stays blocked with all stage receipts null until genuine native-v3 closure publication.

grants.mode: ONE atomic source PR; separate producer PR is superseded
grants.condition: Actual merged/main-proved R0.cni-registration milestone plus parent admission of genuine capture/source/reviewer/census qualification and exact seven-file grant.
Actual source-delivery milestone, genuine captured evidence, finite filenames/hash/bytes frozen before review. Partial prefix never closes CNI0/CNI1.
Actual CNI2 prefix delivery; full remaining genuine canonical publication/intake/portable consumption, debt discharge and cleanup before separate Task1 requalification.

ownership.boundary: Existing literal node/unit paths plus exact ownershipExceptions permit absent files without broad directories. Exceptions are the only new filename grants; no placeholder file creation.
ownership.enforcementGap: NEXT uses unit state/node dependencies and ownershipPaths only; it does not enforce documentary unit predecessors or reserve exception-only names. --git also skips ledger evidence paths. Parent explicitly checks reservations, full changed-file scopes/caps and actual frozen publication filenames; no new validator gate is claimed.

policy.trust: LOCAL three-way independently witnessed observation; noncryptographic
sources: Actual native item_completed/McpToolCall completion frame and result bytes
Matching live App thread/turn/call/status/workdir observations, with all relevant turns reached
Independently witnessed raw session_meta/turn_context route, parent/context and native source provenance/integrity
policy.binding: Freeze/reopen exact record slice/prefix hashes separately from decoded UTF-8 stdout and artifact bytes; trusted observers establish source authenticity. No hash-only or writable-file authentication.
required: Actual owned workdir HEAD/tree/index/diff and relevant dirt
Full current-source/reviewer-output direct byte/hash readbacks and independent reopen without normalization
Exactly one real author and every editing parent/finisher; audited complete-or-empty census
Fresh isolated reviewer distinct from every contributor native session/task identity, no author context; reviewer edits void review
Matching exact local/review/inline/external version, head/output/local/census bindings
Candidate intake plus portable consumption and immutable native archive reopen
policy.refuse: Absent, foreign, stale, changed, aliased, ambiguous, truncated, fabricated, mixed, unknown, partial or downgraded inputs, including no-evidence; no st_ spoof, subscription alias, invented engine fields or fake v2 closure.
policy.markerLimit: The controlled 330-byte marker proves one native result/matching call, not large-output completeness, full census or SOURCE approval.
policy.export: Safe allowlisted projections only; no full session records/transcripts/prompts/reasoning/credentials/environment/private native source paths. Missing root/child fields stay missing.

owners.capture: scripts/qc/roadmap-codex-identity-capture.mjs owns bounded exact-source extraction/capture, not trusted witness manufacture or a second policy validator.
owners.identity: scripts/qc/roadmap-ledger-lib.mjs is the one review-identity policy/validation owner; preserve identityPath archive ownership and all old behavior.
owners.paired: roadmap-unit-closure.mjs and validate-roadmap.mjs dispatch exact matching old/native versions atomically; no broad ID regex change or fake engine-record producer.

publication.rule: Naming contract only, never wildcard write authority. Freeze exact finite actual paths/bytes/hashes under CNI2/CNI3 before review; update exact ownershipExceptions then. Every evidence/snapshot/review/register file counts. Stop before a sixteenth file or any unregistered name. Partial prefixes do not complete a unit.

localEvidence.rule: Private/run evidence outside Git; frozen real census only. Any additional report changes the finite manifest and requires remeasurement/review. Author report is carried by source.log/local.log/qa.md.

lifecycle.bootstrap: CNI0 only: independent exact-head Sol high/xhigh docs review under approved native witnesses, actual required CI/owner gates, guarded merge, actual main proof, evidence reopen and owned cleanup; no administrative bypass.
lifecycle.milestones: R0.cni-registration records actual docs delivery; R6.cni-source actual source delivery; R0.cni-evidence actual prefix delivery; R0.cni-discharge full debt publication. All start unproved and never mean fictional canonical closure.
lifecycle.discharge: Genuine CNI0/CNI1 native-v3 candidate intake and portable acceptance, full actual contributor/reviewer/source/result/witness bindings and published reopened archives, required exact-head delivery and cleanup.
lifecycle.task1: OPEN/BLOCKED until current fetched-main qualification is rerun after full debt discharge; no original task released.
lifecycle.sourceReview: CNI1 fresh isolated exact-head SOURCE reviewer independently reproduces at least two mutants; source merge and fixture success are insufficient.

caps: Preserve exact U41 test/generated/ledger-evidence line exclusions; docs/register additions count unless existing rule excludes them. All modified files count; no new allowance, exemption or cap inflation.

sequence: After actual first registration merge/main proof, ordinary follow-up records that predecessor proof, advances R0.cni-registration to main-verified and ONLY CNI1 to planned
After actual CNI1 source merge/main proof, ordinary follow-up records that predecessor proof, advances R6.cni-source and ONLY CNI2 to planned
After actual CNI2 prefix merge/main proof, ordinary follow-up records that predecessor proof, advances R0.cni-evidence and ONLY CNI3 to planned
milestoneFollowups.gates: Every follow-up needs fresh exact-head review, required CI/owner ruling, guarded merge and actual exact-main proof before successor admission; never prefill own future merge. CNI0 canonical unit stays blocked/native debt OPEN.
milestoneFollowups.caps: All follow-ups stay within the same six-file CNI0 grant; aggregate initial plus follow-up counted additions <=500. Reserve and measure remaining budget. No seventh source file, extra filename or bootstrap exception.
milestoneFollowups.ordering: Insert new units immediately before old NEXT U24b; preserve all 158 original objects and relative order. All CNI units initially blocked; NEXT U24b is honest, later only the eligible CNI successor may become NEXT.

noGrant: Old actor/resource adoption or historical receipt rewrite
validation: Node22.22.0 unchanged portable62-test baseline plus changed --git/accounting/docs/QC/strict gates and actual canonical projection; negative stale/dirt/misleading-success probes are local evidence, never SOURCE or main acceptance.
